arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys, os, re, json, zipfile, shutil

SRC = 'inputs/offer_letter_template.docx'
DATA = 'inputs/employee_data.json'
OUT = 'output/offer_letter_filled.docx'

def fail(msg):
    sys.stderr.write("ERROR: " + msg + "\n")
    sys.exit(1)

with open(DATA, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r'\{\{([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}')
COND_RE = re.compile(r'\{\{IF_RELOCATION\}\}(.*?)\{\{END_IF_RELOCATION\}\}', re.DOTALL)

missing = []

def process_text(text, errors):
    """Process a joined paragraph text: handle conditionals then placeholders."""
    # Conditional: governed ONLY by RELOCATION_PACKAGE
    def cond_sub(m):
        inner = m.group(1)
        if 'RELOCATION_PACKAGE' not in data:
            errors.append('RELOCATION_PACKAGE (required for IF_RELOCATION)')
            return ''
        keep = data.get('RELOCATION_PACKAGE') == 'Yes'
        return inner if keep else ''
    text = COND_RE.sub(cond_sub, text)

    # Placeholder replacement
    def ph_sub(m):
        key = m.group(1)
        if key in ('IF_RELOCATION', 'END_IF_RELOCATION'):
            # leftover (unbalanced) conditional marker - treat as missing/error
            errors.append('unbalanced conditional marker ' + key)
            return m.group(0)
        if key not in data:
            errors.append(key)
            return m.group(0)
        return str(data[key])
    text = PLACEHOLDER_RE.sub(ph_sub, text)
    return text

# Regex to find <w:p ...>...</w:p> (paragraphs). Non-greedy, but paragraphs
# don't nest, so this works for innermost; need care with nested tables which
# contain their own <w:p>. We'll process per-paragraph by matching the
# innermost <w:p> that have no nested <w:p>. Simpler: process each <w:t> run
# group within each paragraph. Use a parser approach over <w:p> boundaries.

WT_RE = re.compile(r'(<w:t\b[^>]*>)(.*?)(</w:t>)', re.DOTALL)

def process_paragraph(ptext, errors):
    """ptext is the inner content of a single paragraph (may contain its own
    runs). Join all <w:t> texts, transform, put result in first <w:t>, blank rest."""
    matches = list(WT_RE.finditer(ptext))
    if not matches:
        return ptext
    joined = ''.join(m.group(2) for m in matches)
    # unescape XML entities for processing
    def unescape(s):
        return s.replace('<','<').replace('>','>').replace('"','"').replace(''',"'").replace('&','&')
    def escape(s):
        return s.replace('&','&').replace('<','<').replace('>','>')
    raw = unescape(joined)
    if '{{' not in raw and 'IF_RELOCATION' not in raw:
        return ptext
    new = process_text(raw, errors)
    new_esc = escape(new)
    # Rebuild: first run gets full text with xml:space preserve; others blank
    out = []
    last = 0
    for idx, m in enumerate(matches):
        out.append(ptext[last:m.start()])
        if idx == 0:
            # ensure xml:space preserve on the opening tag
            open_tag = m.group(1)
            if 'xml:space' not in open_tag:
                open_tag = open_tag[:-1] + ' xml:space="preserve">'
            out.append(open_tag + new_esc + m.group(3))
        else:
            open_tag = m.group(1)
            if 'xml:space' not in open_tag:
                open_tag = open_tag[:-1] + ' xml:space="preserve">'
            out.append(open_tag + '' + m.group(3))
        last = m.end()
    out.append(ptext[last:])
    return ''.join(out)

# Split XML into paragraphs. Paragraphs can nest tables which contain
# paragraphs. We must process innermost paragraphs first so each is isolated.
# Strategy: repeatedly find <w:p ...>...</w:p> that contain NO nested <w:p>.
INNER_P_RE = re.compile(r'<w:p\b[^>]*>(?:(?!<w:p\b|</w:p>).)*?</w:p>', re.DOTALL)
# Also self-closing <w:p/> has no text, skip.

def process_xml(xml, errors):
    # iterate: replace innermost paragraphs' text content
    def repl(m):
        whole = m.group(0)
        # separate opening tag
        om = re.match(r'(<w:p\b[^>]*>)(.*)(</w:p>)', whole, re.DOTALL)
        if not om:
            return whole
        inner = process_paragraph(om.group(2), errors)
        return om.group(1) + inner + om.group(3)
    return INNER_P_RE.sub(repl, xml)

# Build output zip
os.makedirs('output', exist_ok=True)
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
targets = ['word/document.xml'] + [f'word/header{i}.xml' for i in range(1,7)] + [f'word/footer{i}.xml' for i in range(1,7)]

processed = {}
all_errors = []
for name in zin.namelist():
    if name in targets:
        xml = zin.read(name).decode('utf-8')
        errs = []
        xml = process_xml(xml, errs)
        all_errors.extend(errs)
        processed[name] = xml.encode('utf-8')

# dedupe errors but keep required-check semantics
uniq_missing = []
for e in all_errors:
    if e not in uniq_missing:
        uniq_missing.append(e)
if uniq_missing:
    zin.close()
    fail("missing/unresolved requirements: " + ", ".join(uniq_missing))

tmp = OUT + '.tmp'
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data_bytes = processed.get(item.filename)
        if data_bytes is None:
            data_bytes = zin.read(item.filename)
        zout.writestr(item, data_bytes)
zin.close()
shutil.move(tmp, OUT)
print("OK wrote", OUT)

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
def txt(n):
    d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
    return d
# document body paragraph texts
doc=z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
# join per paragraph
for pm in re.finditer(r'<w:p\b[^>]*>.*?</w:p>', doc, re.DOTALL):
    ts=re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>', pm.group(0), re.DOTALL)
    j=''.join(ts)
    if j.strip():
        print('BODY:', repr(j))
print('--- leftover braces in doc:', '{{' in doc, 'IF_RELOCATION' in doc)
for i in range(1,7):
    for k in ('header','footer'):
        n=f'word/{k}{i}.xml'
        d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
        ts=re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>', d, re.DOTALL)
        print(n, repr(''.join(ts)))
"
